description: Hello! My name is John McNale and I've been smoking Camels for almost 40 yrs. Though I do have a few complaints. First, I've found quite a few packs of style Camels packs (also, your company has had many giveaways, free gifts, etc, etc.) but only for filter smokers. Only once has there been a deal for regular smokers, as I recall that didn't last long. I can certainly understand trying to get new people to buy your filters, but what about us die-hard, dedicated customers? I smoke between 2-3 cartons of Camels a week, and all I get is a great cigarette. How about offering us something? Also, what ever happened to Camel wides? They were the closest thing to a regular Camel. In closing, believe me, I'd walk a mile for a Camel, but how about offering us (reg?) smokers a drink of water.
